players.appliedToThePlayerStanding: Applied to the player standing on the server, so they see it happen.
players.levelsAreWhatThePlayer: Levels are what the player sees over their hotbar.
players.pointsAreWhatALevel: Points are what a level is made of, and a level costs more of them the higher it is.
players.toAnotherPlayerWhoIs: To another player who is on, or to a place.
players.dragToRearrangeItOr: Drag to rearrange it, or drop an item from the palette into a slot.
players.asTheServerLastHad: As the server last had it.
players.readFromTheRunningServer: Read from the running server, so it is where they were a moment ago.
players.whatPolarisHasWatchedAnd: What Polaris has watched, and what the world itself has counted.
players.nothingInTheLogThis: Nothing in the log this far back.

players.anyAccountWhateverItIs: Any account, whatever it is called and whether or not it has linked Minecraft. An email that is nobody yet can be invited.
players.ifTheyHaveLinkedMinecraft: If they have linked Minecraft, their name and the addresses they connect from fill themselves in.
players.thisPolarisDoesNotShow: This Polaris does not show where other people sign in from. Ask them for the address they play from.
players.whereverTheyAreSignedIn: Wherever they are signed in to Polaris
players.thatIsNotAUsername: That is not a username this edition accepts
players.thatIsNotAnAddress: That is not an address or a range
players.polarisCouldNotReadThe: Polaris could not read the address this request came from. Type it in instead.
players.leaveItEmptyToChange: Leave it empty to change only the note.
players.useTheAddressYouAre: Use the address you are on now
players.whoThisIsForWhoever: Who this is, for whoever reads the list next. Only Polaris sees it.
players.followsDescription: {player} joins from wherever {account} is signed in to Polaris.
players.linkedDescription: {player} is {account} on Polaris. Where they join from is the addresses below.
players.tiedTo: The account they make is tied to {name}.
players.inviteFailed: The email to {email} could not be sent ({reason}). Send them this link instead.
players.inviteLink: Send {email} this link. When they make their account, it is tied to {name}.
players.invited: Invited {email}. When they make their account, it is tied to {name}.
players.followsHint: They are let in only from an address where {name} is signed in to Polaris, and removed when they sign out.
players.typedGo: The addresses typed for them go.
players.linkedHint: Linked to {name} for who they are. The addresses typed here still decide where they join from.
players.noMinecraft: {name} has not linked Minecraft, so type their username.
players.notSignedIn: {account} is not signed in to Polaris anywhere, so {player} cannot join right now.
